# Standards & federation

Decidiq declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `decidiq.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Open Raadsinformatie (ORI) API](https://github.com/openstate/open-raadsinformatie) | 1.4 | Public | `/apps/decidiq/api/ori/v1` |
| [Popolo (data model of the ORI output)](https://www.popoloproject.com/specs/) | — | Public | `/apps/decidiq/api/ori/v1` |
| [Model Context Protocol tools (meetings, action items, decisions)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification) | — | Nextcloud login | — |

## Standards this app uses

None.

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

Decidiq registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["decidiq"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `decidiq` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
